verdict.rationale: MailerSend documents open and click tracking and filterable delivery logs. The Email API returns an x-message-id that can be used to query a message's status. Webhooks push real-time event notifications. Missing for 10: explicit API docs for a per-message event history (opens, clicks, deliveries listed per message), confirmation that open/click data is exposed through the API rather than only the dashboard, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can track opens and clicks and query a per-message event history via the API to answer 'what happened to this email?'

citations.quote: Track open rates, click-throughs, bounces, and unsubscribes with real-time data.
It returns the status of the email sent with an `x-message-id` that can be used to continuously query for the status using the Email API.
Review message activity with filterable delivery logs.
Webhooks allow you to subscribe to real-time notifications about various events that occur in MailerSend.
